COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1249 of 2026
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. M.C. Pant, learned Counsel for petitioner. 
2. Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, learned S.C. for the State.
3. This petition is filed by petitioner on the 
premise that petitioner has been given contractual 
appointment by respondent nos.2 and 3 with their 
establishment as Certification Inspector after 
advertising the said post and after due selection. 
Subsequently, petitioner worked as contractual 
Certification Inspector for a period of 11 years, but 
suddenly, some irregularities were pointed out by 
employees of respondent nos.2 and 3 upon which 
the matter was enquired into and thereafter the 
employment/engagement of petitioner was shown to 
be under a project of respondent nos.2 and 3. 
Petitioner has filed present writ petition for seeking 
regularization with the prayer to take into 
consideration the entire period of service of 12 years 
for the purpose of regularization. 
4. Issue notice to respondent nos.2 and 3 
returnable within four weeks.
5. Steps within three days.
6. Respondents may file their counter affidavit 
within four weeks.
7. List on 13.07.2026.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 12.05.2026 R.Dang
